caption: A ladder leaning at too shallow an angle against a garden wall slides out at its feet and falls flat to the ground.

sa.check: A ladder leans against a garden wall at a shallow angle.
It falls flat to the ground.
The feet slide first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The feet slip away from the wall first and the top slides down as the angle flattens, with nothing else touching it.
pc.fail: The top moves first with the feet fixed; or the ladder is pushed; or the feet slide toward the wall.

pc.expect: It does not stay propped once the feet move, and it lands flat.
pc.fail: It stays propped after the feet slide; or falls toward or over the wall; or hangs mid-fall.

pc.expect: It falls away from the wall along its own line.
pc.fail: It falls sideways; or upward; or rotates about its middle.

pc.expect: The ladder is rigid and clatters.
pc.fail: It bends; or bounces high; or breaks into pieces.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The ladder and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The ladder changes; or the wall changes; or the garden rearranges.
